note: Chicken thigh and capsicum skewers marinated in honey, mustard and garlic

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the chicken and capsicums into chunks.
Mix the honey, mustard and garlic and toss through the chicken and capsicum.
Marinate in the fridge.
Thread onto long skewers.
Grill until charred and cooked through.

note: Thin crêpes folded around ham and melted gruyere

dish.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Rest the batter.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan.
Fill half with ham and gruyere, fold and warm until melted.
Sprinkle the rest with sugar and lemon juice and fold into quarters.

note: Cob loaf layered with olive salad, salami, ham and provolone

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, press overnight

steps.text: Chop the olives and giardiniera together for an olive salad.
Hollow the loaf slightly.
Layer with olive salad, salami, ham and provolone, then more olive salad.
Wrap tightly and press under a heavy weight overnight in the fridge.
Cut into small wedges.

note: Puff pastry rolls of pork mince, onion and sage

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Mix the pork with the onion, sage and salt.
Halve the pastry sheets and lay the filling along each piece, then roll up and seal.
Brush with beaten egg and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden and cooked through.
Serve hot with English mustard.

note: Prawns crumbed in shredded coconut and panko, fried

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Mix the coconut with the panko.
Dip the prawns in beaten egg, then press into the coconut mix.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden.
Stir lime juice into the sweet chilli sauce and serve for dipping.

note: Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, with a fish sauce dip

steps.text: Peel the prawns. Toss with the garlic, chilli and lime zest.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar for the dipping sauce.
Thread the prawns onto skewers.
Grill in batches, turning once, until pink.
Serve from the boat with the dipping sauce.

note: Prawns, vermicelli and herbs in rice paper, with a peanut hoisin dip

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water until soft, then drain.
Prepare the prawns, herbs and lettuce.
Warm the peanut butter with the hoisin and a splash of water for a thick dipping sauce.
Soak the rice paper sheets one at a time, fill with prawns, vermicelli, herbs and lettuce and roll tightly.

note: Dark and white chocolate swirled with gummy lollies, honeycomb and marshmallows

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 week in an airtight tin

steps.text: Melt the dark and white chocolate separately.
Spread the dark chocolate over a lined tray and drizzle with the white, then swirl with a skewer.
Scatter over the lollies, honeycomb, marshmallows and sprinkles, pressing them in lightly.
Chill until set.
Smash into shards.

note: Tuna, mayo, celery and pickle on toasted English muffins

steps.text: Split and toast the muffins.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, celery, pickles, a squeeze of lemon and pepper.
Spread over the muffin halves and top with cheddar.
Grill until the cheese is bubbling and golden.
Cut each half into quarters and serve warm.

note: Cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and ham and mustard

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs until hard, then cool.
Mash the eggs with salt and mayonnaise.
Spread bread with cream cheese and layer with cucumber.
Fill more with the egg and mustard cress, and the rest with ham and a little mustard.
Cut off the crusts, slice into fingers and stack on a tiered plate.

note: Pastry rounds filled with beef, potato, swede and onion

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Dice the steak, potato, swede and onion.
Mix with the salt and plenty of pepper.
Cut rounds about 20cm wide from the pastry.
Pile the filling onto one half of each, dot with butter, fold over and crimp the edge.
Brush with beaten egg and cut a small slit.
Bake at 200C.
Reduce to 170C and bake until golden and the filling is cooked.
Serve with brown sauce.

note: Blinis with creme fraiche and black roe, white chocolate dipped strawberries

steps.text: Melt the white chocolate gently.
Dip the strawberries halfway in the chocolate and set on baking paper.
Leave the chocolate to set.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche and a little black roe.
Lay both out on black trays in strict rows, black and white only.

note: Fried rolls of pork mince, wombok, carrot and rice vermicelli

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli until soft, drain and chop.
Shred the wombok and grate the carrots.
Cook the pork mince until browned.
Mix the pork with the vermicelli and vegetables and cool.
Roll tightly in the spring roll pastry.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and blistered.
Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.

note: Bite size chicken thigh coated in panko and paprika, shallow fried

steps.text: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Mix the flour, panko, paprika and salt. Dip the chicken in egg, then in the crumb mix.
Shallow fry in batches until golden.
Drain and serve with honey mustard.

note: Pork and beef meatballs browned and simmered in cream with allspice

steps.text: Mix the mince with the onion and allspice, then roll into small balls.
Brown the meatballs.
Add the cream and a splash of water and simmer.
Serve on toothpicks with lingonberry jam.

note: Cocktail franks in a cornmeal buttermilk batter, fried

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and buttermilk to a thick batter.
Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each.
Dip in the batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden.
Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

note: Blue jelly in glasses topped with whipped cream and an orange slice

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before

ingredients.item: boiling and cold water, as the packet says

steps.text: Make up the jelly following the packet.
Pour into glasses.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream.
Top with cream and tuck a slice of orange on each for a little orange fish.

note: Soft boiled eggs wrapped in sage sausage meat, crumbed and fried

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Boil 6 of the eggs until just set.
Cool and peel the eggs.
Mix the sausage meat with the sage and pepper.
Wrap the sausage meat around each egg.
Roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 170C in two batches.
Halve and serve with mustard.

note: Oatcakes with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and lemon

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Spread the oatcakes with cream cheese.
Top with folds of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill.
Squeeze over a little lemon and lay out on a slate.

note: Crisp baked wings tossed in barbecue sauce and honey, sour cream dip

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce with the honey.
Toss the wings through the sauce.
Mix the sour cream with the mayonnaise and chives for a ranch dip and serve alongside.

note: Thin crêpes folded around ham and gruyere, crisped in the pan

dish.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Rest the batter.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan.
Fill each with ham and gruyere and fold into quarters.
Crisp again in the pan.
Cut into triangles and serve hot.

note: Mini bagels with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and red onion

steps.text: Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with cream cheese.
Top each with a fold of smoked salmon, a few capers and thin slices of red onion.
Lay them out on a tray.

note: Pork mince, wombok, ginger and spring onion, pan fried

steps.text: Mix the pork with the wombok, ginger, spring onion and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry in oil until crisp underneath.
Add a splash of water, cover and steam.
Serve with black vinegar.

note: Mango puree set with gelatine and evaporated milk

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blend 2 mangoes into a puree.
Warm the puree with the sugar.
Soak the gelatine sheets until soft.
Squeeze the gelatine and stir into the warm puree until dissolved.
Stir in the evaporated milk.
Pour into glasses.
Chill until set.
Dice the remaining mango and use to top the puddings.

note: Small beef patties with cheese and pickles on slider buns

steps.text: Shape the mince into small patties and season.
Cook on a hot pan, turning once, adding a slice of cheese at the end.
Put into the buns with pickles and tomato sauce.

film: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (2009)
note: Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, small shortcrust fruit mince tarts

steps.text: Cut the shortcrust into small rounds and press into a patty tin.
Fill with fruit mince.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Cool the tarts.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill.
Arrange both on trays.

film: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 (2010)
note: Blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and dill, plus gruyere choux puffs

steps.text: Top the blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and dill.
Boil the water with the butter for the gougeres.
Beat in the flour until the dough pulls away from the pan.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the gruyere.
Pipe small balls onto lined trays.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Arrange both on silver trays.

film: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 (2010)
note: Mayo and lemon crab on toasted sourdough fingers

steps.text: Fold the crab through the mayonnaise with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and the chives.
Toast the sourdough and cut into fingers.
Pile the crab on top.
Finish with smoked paprika.

film: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2 (2011)
note: Crisp baked wings glazed with honey, soy and red chilli

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the honey with the soy sauce and chilli until sticky.
Toss the wings through the sauce.
Scatter with sesame seeds.

note: Aged cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, apple and crusty bread

dish.n: Cheddar, pork pie and pickle board

steps.text: Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the pork pies.
Cut the apples into wedges and tear the bread.
Pile everything onto a big board so guests can raid it at once.

film: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies (2014)
note: Rye crispbread with creme fraiche, smoked trout, dill and pickled onion

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice a few pickled onions into thin rings and pick the dill into small sprigs.
Spread each rye crispbread with creme fraiche.
Flake the smoked trout over the top and finish with a dill sprig and a few onion rings.
Arrange on a wooden board and serve cold.

film: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies (2014)
note: Muffin tin pies of beef and onion gravy under puff pastry

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled (bake fresh)

steps.text: Dice the onion and cut the pastry into rounds to fit a 12-hole muffin tin.
Brown the mince and onion in oil, add the stock and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling for 15 minutes while you line the tin with shortcrust rounds.
Fill each case, top with a puff pastry lid and cut a small steam hole.
Bake at 200C until golden, then serve with tomato sauce.

film: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)
note: Buttered toast fingers with mashed sardine and lemon, or honey

steps.text: Toast the bread and butter it while hot.
Mash the sardines with a squeeze of lemon and spread on half the toast.
Drizzle honey over the rest.
Cut into fingers and serve with a pot of tea.

note: Raspberry jelly set in glasses with whole raspberries

steps.text: Make up the jelly as the packet says.
Divide the raspberries between four glasses and pour the jelly over.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream, dust the jellies with glitter and top with cream.

film: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
note: Pizza dough wrapped around mozzarella and pepperoni, baked in a tin

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in the oven

steps.text: Cube the mozzarella and heat the oven to 200C.
Cut the dough into small pieces and wrap each around a cube of cheese and a slice of pepperoni.
Roll into balls and pack into a greased tin.
Bake until golden.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic and brush over the balls. Warm the sauce for dipping.

film: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
note: Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with a charred tomato chilli sauce

steps.text: Mix the mince with sliced spring onion and ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam the momos.
Char the tomatoes in a dry pan, then blitz with chilli flakes, salt and garlic for the achar.

note: Grilled hot dogs with yellow mustard and warm sauerkraut

steps.text: Warm the sauerkraut with the caraway seeds.
Grill the franks until they split.
Tuck into the buns with mustard and sauerkraut and wrap in wax paper.

note: Aged cheddar, ham, pickled onions, chutney and crusty bread

steps.text: Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the bread thickly.
Lay the cheese, ham, onions and chutney on a board with the bread and butter.

note: Crisp baked wings with smoked paprika and honey barbecue glaze

steps.text: Toss the wings with paprika and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce, honey and butter until glossy.
Toss the wings through the glaze and serve with napkins.

film: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016)
note: Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, figs with goat's cheese and honey

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Halve the figs and tear the salmon into small folds.
Top each blini with creme fraiche and smoked salmon.
Top each fig half with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey.
Arrange both on silver trays.

film: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016)
note: Rye crispbread with creme fraiche, smoked trout, pickled onion and dill

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice a few pickled onions into rings and pick the dill into sprigs.
Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Flake the trout over the top and finish with onion rings and dill.
Serve cold on a slate.

note: Buttermilk pancakes stacked with crisp bacon

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs and buttermilk to a thick batter.
Cook small pancakes in butter until golden.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Stack the pancakes with bacon between and pour over maple syrup.

note: Rye crispbread with creme fraiche, smoked salmon, dill and pickled onion

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice a few pickled onions into rings.
Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Top with a fold of salmon, a sprig of dill and onion rings.
Serve cold on a slate.

note: Baked beef empanadas with cumin and green olives

steps.text: Dice the onion and chop the olives.
Brown the mince with onion and cumin, stir in the olives and cool.
Cut pastry into rounds, fill, fold and crimp.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Blitz parsley, garlic, vinegar and oil for chimichurri.

note: Bacon, fried egg and cheddar in toasted English muffins

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Fry the eggs until just set.
Split and toast the muffins and butter them.
Fill each with bacon, egg and cheese and wrap tightly in paper so the cheese melts.

note: Pork belly roasted until the skin puffs and crackles

steps.text: Score the skin and rub with salt.
Dry uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 240C.
Drop to 180C and roast until puffed and crackling.
Cut into bites and serve with lime wedges and hot sauce.

note: Bacon, potato and clam chowder with milk and cream

steps.text: Dice the bacon, onion and potatoes.
Fry the bacon, then soften the onion and potato in butter.
Add the clams with their juice and the milk and simmer.
Stir in the cream, season well and ladle into small cups with oyster crackers.

note: Twice fried chips under thick beef gravy

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and dry well.
Fry the chips once at a lower heat until soft.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer until thick.
Fry the chips again at high heat until crisp.
Pile into bowls, scatter with torn mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy.

note: Medjool dates wrapped in bacon and baked

steps.text: Halve the bacon rashers and pit the dates.
Wrap bacon around each date and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C on a lined tray, turning once, until the bacon is crisp.

note: Sushi rice triangles around flaked grilled salmon, wrapped in nori

steps.text: Rinse and cook the rice, then let it cool until warm.
Salt and grill the salmon, then flake it.
Shape the rice into triangles around a little salmon.
Wrap the base in nori and sprinkle with sesame.
Pack into a bento box with pickled ginger.

note: Chicken thigh skewers grilled with a soy and mirin glaze

steps.text: Soak 12 bamboo skewers in water. Cut the chicken into pieces and thread onto skewers.
Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the skewers, basting with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with sliced spring onion.

note: Dark and milk chocolate with marshmallows, set in a tin

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight

steps.text: Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.
Melt both chocolates together in short bursts in the microwave.
Stir in the marshmallows, broken honeycomb, peanuts and lollies.
Spread into the tin and chill until firm.
Smash or cut into chunks and pile in a bowl.

note: Chicken thigh chunks in panko, baked until golden

steps.text: Cut the chicken into chunks. Beat the eggs.
Dip in egg and press into panko.
Spread on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C.
Mix the honey and mustard for dipping.

note: Tortillas filled with chicken, cheddar, mozzarella and capsicum

steps.text: Dice the capsicum and slice the spring onions.
Mix the chicken, cheese, capsicum, spring onions and paprika.
Spread over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat, a few minutes a side, until golden and melted.
Cut each into four wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

note: Grape jelly with whipped cream and two banana slices on top

steps.text: Make up the jelly as the packet says and pour into clear cups.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream and swirl on top.
Add two banana slices to each like goggles.

note: Ham and gruyere sandwiches topped with bechamel and more cheese

steps.text: Make a bechamel from the butter, flour and milk.
Spread the bread with Dijon, fill with ham and gruyere and arrange on a tray.
Top with bechamel and more grated cheese.
Grill until bubbling.
Cut into small squares and serve on a silver tray.

note: Soft boiled eggs wrapped in pork sausage, crumbed and fried

steps.text: Boil the four eggs, cool and peel.
Boil.
Cool.
Wrap each egg in sausage mince.
Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Fry at 170C until golden.
Halve and serve with mustard.

note: Navy beans simmered with bacon, molasses and Dijon

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheats well

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight.
Soak.
Simmer the beans in fresh water until tender.
Fry the bacon with the chopped onion, then stir in the beans, molasses, mustard and water to cover.
Simmer until thick and smoky.
Serve in tin cups.

note: Cheddar cubes, salami, water crackers and pickled onions in small tins

steps.text: Cube the cheddar and slice the salami.
Pack small tins with crackers, cheese, salami and pickled onions.
Close the lids and hand them out.

note: Puff pastry parcels filled with ham and cheddar

dish.n: Ham and cheese puff pastry triangles

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the pastry into squares and grate the cheese.
Fill each with ham and cheddar, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake until golden.

note: Rye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and lemon

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Pick the dill into sprigs.
Spread the crispbreads with cream cheese.
Top with folds of salmon and a sprig of dill.
Squeeze over a little lemon and lay on a wooden board.

note: Small pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Roll the dough thin and cut into small rounds.
Top each with sauce, grated mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and oregano.
Bake until crisp and bubbling.

note: Blue jelly in clear glasses with mango and kiwi fish shapes set inside

steps.text: Cut the mango and kiwifruit into little fish shapes.
Make up the jelly and pour into clear glasses with the fruit suspended inside.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream and spoon on top like sea foam.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides (2011)
note: Green prawns poached in lemon water, chilled, served on crushed ice

steps.text: Slice the lemons. Bring salted water with lemon slices to the boil and fill a bowl with iced water.
Poach the prawns, then plunge into the iced water.
Peel the prawns.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce and serve the prawns on crushed ice.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales (2017)
note: Prawns in an ice cold soda water batter, fried until crisp, with a lime dip

steps.text: Peel the prawns. Whisk the flour, cornflour and soda water to a thin, lumpy batter.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip the prawns in the batter and fry until puffed and crisp.
Stir lime juice into the sweet chilli sauce for dipping.

note: Green prawns grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butter

steps.text: Crush the garlic, chop the chilli, zest and juice a lime and cut the rest into wedges. Melt the butter.
Toss the prawns with garlic, chilli, zest and butter.
Grill a couple of minutes a side until charred.
Pile onto a platter with lime wedges and pour over the pan butter.

note: Thin crust pizza with mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano

steps.text: Heat the oven to 250C. Stretch the dough thin on a big tray.
Spread with sauce, grated mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.
Bake until bubbling.
Cut into squares.

note: Cocktail sausages wrapped in puff pastry strips and baked

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the pastry into 24 strips.
Wrap a strip around each sausage, seam underneath, and lay on a lined tray.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake until puffed and golden.
Line up on a board with tomato sauce and mustard.

note: Toasted marshmallow and dark chocolate sandwiched between sweet biscuits

steps.text: Break the chocolate into squares.
Toast the marshmallows over a flame or under a hot grill until golden.
Sandwich each between two biscuits with chocolate, squashing so it melts.

film: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore (2022)
note: Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with a charred tomato chilli sauce

steps.text: Mix the mince with sliced spring onion and ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam.
Char the tomatoes in a dry pan and blitz with chilli flakes and salt for dipping.

note: Prawn skewers grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butter

steps.text: Soak 8 skewers. Crush the garlic, chop the chilli, zest a lime and cut the rest into wedges. Melt the butter.
Toss the prawns with garlic, chilli, zest and butter and thread onto skewers.
Grill a couple of minutes a side until charred.
Serve with lime wedges and spoon over any butter left in the pan.

note: Coconut milk set with gelatine in glasses, topped with diced mango

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine sheets in cold water. Dice the mangoes.
Warm the coconut milk with sugar until dissolved.
Squeeze the gelatine and stir in.
Pour into glasses and chill until set.
Top with mango and passionfruit pulp.

note: Paprika roast wedges topped with cheddar and crisp bacon

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with oil and paprika.
Roast at 220C.
Fry the bacon until crisp, grate the cheddar and slice the spring onions.
Top the wedges with cheddar and bacon and bake.
Add sour cream and spring onion.
